2. SCOPE OF WORK EXECUTED
Irrigation works for Irrigation & Waterways Dept, Govt of Rajasthan completed 2021.
The work was carried out under site conditions that included a high water table requiring continuous dewatering. The agency organised
its resources around this without recourse to the department for additional assistance, and the programme was re-sequenced locally to
keep the critical path intact.
An extension of time was granted during execution on account of delayed handover of the site frontage by the local authority. The delay
was examined by this office and held to be beyond the agency's control; no compensation was claimed and none has been paid.
The above work was executed under the supervision of the undersigned in accordance with the approved drawings, specifications, and
the terms and conditions of the contract. The work has been completed in all respects and has been got inspected by the Engineer-in-
Chief / Superintending Engineer.
3. QUALITY ASSESSMENT
The overall quality of the completed work is graded Satisfactory. Workmanship was acceptable with minor rework at two locations, and
the work was inspected in stages, with each stage recorded in the measurement book. Materials were drawn from approved sources
and the test results filed with this office were within the limits prescribed in the contract specification.

5. DEFICIENCY / OBSERVATION LIST
At the time of taking over, two hand-railing sections replaced during the defect liability period. Regarding site safety, the site maintained
its safety induction register without lapse. The agency's conduct during the contract is recorded as cooperative, with weekly progress
reporting maintained without prompting.
Nil. No major deficiencies observed during the final inspection carried out on 2021-07-26. All minor observations pointed out during the
interim inspections have been rectified to the satisfaction of the inspecting authority.
6. RECOMMENDATION
Having satisfied myself as to the quantity and quality of the work executed, and on the basis of the joint measurements recorded in the
measurement book, I certify the work complete and recommend release of the balance payment together with the retention money due
on expiry of the defect liability period. Certified by T. Iyer, Executive Engineer.
The agency attended to all observations raised during execution and the work was taken over on satisfactory completion of the final
inspection.
This certificate is issued for the sole purpose of recording completion of the above work and does not absolve the contractor of any obligations under the contract,
including the defect liability period.
